traderLens.name: Minervini
traderLens.view: Stage 2 requires breadth and volume; 46.8% of names above the 200SMA and 34.2% near highs is not a broad Stage 2 tape. The only valid VCP structures sitting in a leading sector are energy/gas names (GFR, 2.1x RVOL). Everything else is either extended (EFXT, RGC) or a pullback without volume confirmation (AAPL, AMD at 0.79x). He sits largely in cash today.

traderLens.name: Ted Zhang
traderLens.view: The rotation is explicit: XLU RS 95, XLP RS 70, XLE RS 70 vs XLV RS 35, XLF RS 35, XLY RS 20. Money is moving from growth/large-cap tech into defensive-income plus energy. The tactical play is to stay long the flow (energy refiners VLO/DINO/PBF/PARR, gas GFR) and let the tech pullback finish before re-engaging.
